page.title: Track a shipment
page.intro: Enter your PickLoads tracking number and the delivery ZIP code — or the access code from your confirmation — to see where your freight is.
page.meta_description: Track a PickLoads shipment with your tracking number and delivery ZIP code. Milestone updates entered by our dispatch team — no account needed.
page.gate_notice: PickLoads brokerage shipments begin once our FMCSA broker authority and BMC-84 bond are active. If you are a dispatch customer, your loads are tracked inside the Carrier Portal.
page.help_body: Your tracking number is on your confirmation email and on the bill of lading. If the delivery ZIP code doesn't work, try the access code from the same email. Still stuck? Call (908) 404-5373 — dispatch answers 7 days a week.
page.noscript_body: Swiv chajman an bezwen JavaScript aktive. Si ou pa ka aktive l, rele (908) 404-5373 — yon repartitè ap chèche chajman ou an epi li ba ou dènye enfòmasyon an.
page.privacy_note: We ask for two pieces of information because a tracking number on its own is not a password. We log every lookup attempt.
